# spec_wi-due-dates-overdue: Optional due date on todos, overdue flag, and GET /todos/overdue

> Factory run `run_57fde1adc2` · outcome: Todos with due dates and an overdue view · design record: `.factory/runs/run_57fde1adc2/` on this branch

## Summary

What changed: POST /todos takes an optional due_date (null, or a real YYYY-MM-DD date; anything else gets 422 and nothing is stored). Every todo response gains due_date and a derived overdue flag (open AND due_date strictly before the current UTC date), and the new GET /todos/overdue returns exactly the overdue todos in id order. 5 files change, all inside allowed_paths: app/storage.py (+today_utc, Todo.is_overdue/to_dict, TodoStore.list_dicts), app/main.py (TodoIn.due_date + validator, new route), README.md, tests/test_overdue.py (36 tests), tests/e2e_overdue.py.

Contested and settled (I re-ran each on a clean clone of 93ced45): F-1, a torn done/overdue pair in POST responses under a concurrent complete(): fixed with a snapshot in to_dict. My race probe gives 0 torn in 20000 at head and 70 with the round-1 to_dict, and the new regression test fails on the round-1 code. F-2, today_utc() could use the host date undetected: fixed. With TZ=UTC, the mutants date.today(), datetime.now().date() and datetime.now().astimezone().date() each fail test_today_utc_is_the_utc_date_not_the_host_date and 3 local-all checks. Old F-3, an intermediate commit that stored malformed dates: the history was rebuilt, d33b244 is not an ancestor of HEAD, and every remaining commit gives 422 for the datetime and integer values. All 8 deterministic checks pass.

Still open (nit, non-blocking, reproduced): F-5. The F-1 regression test only catches the asdict-first read order. Rewriting to_dict as `overdue = self.is_overdue(today); return {**asdict(self), ...}` passes all 39 pytest tests, local-all and rollover-local, yet my probe shows 110 torn responses in 20000. Decide whether to accept this or ask for the 10-line second hook (patch Todo.is_overdue) as a follow-up.

Evidence for the criteria: AC-1..AC-9 each have a named test in tests/test_overdue.py, a local-all check and an orchestrator e2e run (test_results.json, 9/9 exit 0). AC-10 rests on test_overdue_flips_when_the_date_advances_without_a_write plus rollover-local. AC-11: 39 passed, with tests/test_todos.py unchanged. AC-12/13: static plan commands exit 0. Know this about the 'preview': it was an orchestrator-started local instance (mode local, 127.0.0.1:54991, not a deployed environment), and the reviewer could not reach it.

Read first: app/storage.py (to_dict snapshot and list_dicts under the lock), then the TodoIn validator in app/main.py, then tests/test_overdue.py tests test_post_response_stays_consistent_when_completed_while_it_is_built and test_today_utc_is_the_utc_date_not_the_host_date.

## Decisions needed from you

None. The judge found no accepted-risk items. (The judge's residual risks, including the open nit F-5, are listed in `.factory/runs/run_57fde1adc2/evidence/spec_wi-due-dates-overdue/merge_readiness.json`.)

## Acceptance criteria

Status is the reviewer's (`findings.json` spec_conformance). The reviewer could not reach the orchestrator's local preview instance, so it marked AC-1..AC-10 `not_assessed` on the preview entries; the orchestrator's own e2e runs (all exit 0) are listed in Verification. Full AC text is in the spec; full reviewer evidence is in findings.json.

| AC | Summary | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| AC-1 | Title-only and unknown-field POSTs return 201 with keys id, title, done, created_at, due_date, overdue; due_date null, overdue false; unknown fields ignored | not_assessed | Local: pytest test_title_only_and_unknown_field_keep_existing_behaviour; local-all PASS compat. Orchestrator e2e: compat exit 0. |
| AC-2 | Future date or null due_date echoed, overdue false | not_assessed | Local: pytest test_future_and_null_due_dates_are_echoed_and_not_overdue; local-all PASS create-future. Orchestrator e2e: create-future exit 0. |
| AC-3 | Past due_date accepted, overdue true in POST and GET /todos | not_assessed | Local: pytest test_past_due_date_is_accepted_and_overdue; local-all PASS create-past; race probe 0 torn at head. Orchestrator e2e: create-past exit 0. |
| AC-4 | Overdue true for D-1, false for D and D+1 (strictly before today, UTC) | not_assessed | Local: pytest test_overdue_is_strictly_before_today[day/month-edge/year-edge], test_today_utc_is_the_utc_date_not_the_host_date; local-all PASS boundary under TZ=<+14>-14. Orchestrator e2e: boundary exit 0. |
| AC-5 | GET /todos: id order, exact keys, overdue equals the rule for every element | not_assessed | Local: pytest test_listing_obeys_rule_for_every_element, test_list_endpoints_read_the_clock_once_per_request[list]; local-all PASS listing; 0 violations across 649 reads under 357 concurrent writes. Orchestrator e2e: listing exit 0. |
| AC-6 | GET /todos/overdue returns exactly open past-due todos (a then f), 200 | not_assessed | Local: pytest test_overdue_list_is_exactly_open_past_due_todos_in_id_order; local-all PASS overdue-list. Orchestrator e2e: overdue-list exit 0. |
| AC-7 | GET /todos/overdue returns 200 with [] when nothing is overdue | not_assessed | Local: pytest test_overdue_list_is_empty_list_when_nothing_is_overdue; local-all PASS empty-overdue --strict. Orchestrator e2e: empty-overdue exit 0 (shape only). |
| AC-8 | Completing a past-due todo gives overdue false and removes it from the overdue list; unknown id 404 | not_assessed | Local: pytest test_completing_clears_overdue_and_removes_from_list; local-all PASS complete. Orchestrator e2e: complete exit 0. |
| AC-9 | 16 malformed due_date values each give 422 and store nothing; 2028-02-29 accepted, 2027-02-29 rejected | not_assessed | Local: 17 parametrized pytest cases give 422 with no todo stored; local-all PASS malformed; every commit in main..HEAD rejects the datetime and integer values. Orchestrator e2e: malformed exit 0. |
| AC-10 | Overdue flips at a date rollover with no write (derived, never stored) | not_assessed | No live evidence by owner decision. pytest test_overdue_flips_when_the_date_advances_without_a_write and `rollover-local` PASS. Orchestrator e2e: listing exit 0 (per-request invariant only). |
| AC-11 | Whole suite passes; tests/test_todos.py unedited | met | 39 passed (3 existing + 36 new) on Python 3.12 and 3.11; `git diff --exit-code main -- tests/test_todos.py` exits 0; all 36 new tests are red on base. |
| AC-12 | Only allowed_paths changed; protected files equal main; import allow-list; no extra=/model_config/ConfigDict | met | Plan commands 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 exit 0; 5 changed files, no untracked files; scope check shown to fail on a stray file. |
| AC-13 | README and app/main.py docstring contain the required strings and state the rule correctly | met | Plan command 7 exits 0; docstring app/main.py:3-4; README.md:15-30 states the rule, the [] response and the 422. |

## What was contested

- **F-1** minor: torn done/overdue pair in POST responses under a concurrent complete() → implementer `fixed` → reviewer `withdrawn` → judge: withdrawal confirmed by execution; 0 torn in 20000 at head, 70 with the round-1 to_dict.
- **F-2** minor: today_utc() could use the host date undetected (also filed as F-3 in findings.json) → implementer `fixed` → reviewer `withdrawn` → judge: confirmed; host-date mutants fail pytest and 3 local-all checks under TZ=UTC.
- **Round-1 F-3 (F-4 in round 2)** nit: commit d33b244 stored malformed due dates → implementer `fixed` (history rebuilt) → reviewer `withdrawn` → judge: accepted; d33b244 is not an ancestor of HEAD and every remaining commit returns 422.
- **DET-ac_test_mapping** → implementer `fixed` → reviewer `withdrawn` → judge: settled by the orchestrator; ac_test_mapping passed.
- **F-5** nit: F-1 regression test catches only one read order (new in round 2, no implementer response) → reviewer `open` → judge: stands as a non-blocking nit, reproduced (110 torn in 20000 with an overdue-first to_dict that passes the whole plan). Decide: accept, or ask for a follow-up hook test.
